supporting_facts: The opening has a high rate of first gas observed (95.3%) compared to baseline (74.8%), indicating early gas collection.
The key sequence typically starts with a Gateway, then Gas, Gas2, and Cybernetics Core before expanding, as seen in the medoid replay.
The opening has a high rate of first production observed (99.2%) and a higher than baseline rate of having a Cybernetics Core (78.0% vs 61.6%).
